visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a dimly lit living room with warm lighting, a woman with long brown hair in a grey sweatshirt sits on a mat. She holds a young boy in a white t-shirt on her lap while they both look at a tall, colorful magnetic marble run toy. The woman adjusts a yellow plastic piece at the top. (2) On an outdoor rooftop patio with a grey metal pergola, the woman, now wearing a tan cap and white t-shirt, squats down next to the boy. They are looking at small colored balls on the ground. (3) In a narrow paved alleyway between traditional low-rise buildings, the woman carries the boy in her arms, running and laughing towards the camera under clear daylight. (4) Back on the rooftop at dusk, the boy runs excitedly across the tiles, holding colorful balls, with city buildings visible in the background. (5) Inside a car, the boy sits in a grey car seat, laughing brightly as a large black and white dog looks on from the back seat. (6) In a modern, minimalist room with concrete floors, the boy runs toward the woman who is kneeling on a large grey cushion. (7) The woman, wearing a green and white hoodie and sunglasses, drives a car on a highway, making a peace sign at the camera. (8) Shots of desert landscapes and the Las Vegas skyline with the 'Resorts World' building appear as the car travels along a multi-lane highway. (9) At the entrance of a bookstore with a 'The Best Bookstore' sign, the woman and boy walk through the door. (10) At a Disney theme park, the woman and boy appear thrilled, surrounded by 'Green Squad' signage and later riding a spinning ride. (11) The woman pushes a red shopping cart through a large retail store like Target while the boy walks beside her. (12) Inside a home kitchen, the woman prepares food while the boy stands in a large kitchen sink, appearing to play with water. (13) At night, the woman, now in a red cap, loads a large pink suitcase into the trunk of a blue SUV. (14) The blue SUV is shown driving on a straight desert road toward the horizon. (15) At a gas station, the woman in a blue hoodie and black cap pumps gas into the SUV. (16) At an airport or garage at night, the woman and boy are met by a man who helps with luggage near a white car. (17) In a desert yard with a pink house, a group of three (two women and the boy) pose for a photo in front of the blue SUV as the camera pans out to an aerial view.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Emotional Hook -> Travel Montage -> Service Introduction -> CTA/Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle-focused promotion for 'Sky Horse' (天馬租車), a car rental service in California catering to Taiwanese travelers. It uses an emotional narrative about motherhood and family bonding to build trust, followed by a vibrant travelogue of California landmarks to showcase the utility and reliability of their rental cars for a successful family vacation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly names the brand 'Sky Horse', details their services (Line communication, Chinese service, airport pickup), and displays their logo/text on screen.
